searchText: opening this to group the account-model PRs in one place, since they're really one direction and easier to review together than scattered. the way i read it, 8130 is the clean profile of 8141 (same validation rule, one reads the authority as data, the other stops on an empty record), and 8403 is the authority-lifecycle layer on top. if that holds, an 8130-first l2 reaches full 8141 as a superset with no user migration. this is how i've come to see it, not settled, so push back where it breaks. the three PRs in this direction: - EIP-8141 sender-keyed authority read, so frames can read a shared authorization step / keystore: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12340 - EIP-8130 optional model-neutral change digest for portable actor changes: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12341 - ERC-8403 Account Authority Lifecycle: https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1979 normative discussion stays on the magicians threads (8141 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/27617, 8130 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/25952, 8403 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/29570), this thread is for coordination and review pointers.

opening this to group the account-model PRs in one place, since they're really one direction and easier to review together than scattered.

the way i read it, 8130 is the clean profile of 8141 (same validation rule, one reads the authority as data, the other stops on an empty record), and 8403 is the authority-lifecycle layer on top. if that holds, an 8130-first l2 reaches full 8141 as a superset with no user migration. this is how i've come to see it, not settled, so push back where it breaks.

the three PRs in this direction:
- EIP-8141 sender-keyed authority read, so frames can read a shared authorization step / keystore: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12340
- EIP-8130 optional model-neutral change digest for portable actor changes: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12341
- ERC-8403 Account Authority Lifecycle: https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1979

normative discussion stays on the magicians threads (8141 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/27617, 8130 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/25952, 8403 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/29570), this thread is for coordination and review pointers.
